thread:
sanjay: We need to schedule the PIR for INC-2026-03 (partial customer throttling). Looking for a facilitator and 30–45m slot. Prefer this week.
laura: I can facilitate if no one objects. prefer afternoons PST.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-03 post-incident template created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-03/template (auto)
rachel: I can attend and help with customer-impact section. availability: Tue 14:00-16:00 PST, Wed 09:00-11:00 PST.
mike: I'm on-call Thu morning but free Wed afternoon. Could do Wed 10:30 PST.
ying: Need to be there for the routing/fallback timeline. Wed 10:30-11:00 PST works for me.
sanjay: Ok Wed 10:30 PST sounds like a winner. Laura — do you want to take facilitator? If yes I'll set invite and pre-read.
laura: I'll take it. I'll aim for a 45m slot to get through timeline + action triage.
sanjay: Thanks. Required attendees: oncall, runtime, platform deploy leads, customer success. Optional: product PM. Pinged @customer-success in the invite.
laura: Quick ask — can someone drop the customer impact summary into the doc before the PIR? I want a short binder: who affected, duration, mitigation steps.
rachel: I'll draft the customer-impact blurb by EOD. Will add metrics for throttled requests and error rate.
mike: I'll add the paging timeline and mitigation steps (what we did, fallbacks triggered).
ying: I'll include routing config diffs and the fallback policy that didn't trigger.
sanjay: Cool. I'll create the calendar invite for Wed 2026-04-01 10:30-11:15 PST and attach the post-incident doc. Invite will include a short pre-read + action-item tracker.
ops-bot: Calendar event created by sanjay: PIR - INC-2026-03 — Wed 2026-04-01 10:30-11:15 PST. Link: https://calendar.redwood/c/abc123
laura: Added facilitator notes section and timeboxed agenda: 10:30 quick context, 10:40 timeline, 10:55 root cause & mitigations, 11:05 actions & owners, 11:15 close.
rachel: I added the customer-impact summary and a sample query for QA: `SELECT count(*) FROM proxy_logs WHERE incident_id='INC-2026-03' AND status='throttled'`
mike: Flag — need action owner for 'ensure fallback policy triggers at 80% capacity'. I volunteer to own triage and follow-up.
sanjay: Assigned to @mike for follow-up in the doc. Laura, can you moderate action assignments during PIR so we leave with owners + ETA?
laura: Yep, I'll run the action tracker and assign preliminary ETAs.
ops-bot: Reminder will be posted 24h before the event.
sanjay: One more: please add any related runbooks to the doc and mark blockers we couldn't resolve during mitigation. Helps with remediation scope.
ying: Will add the routing runbook link and a short note on where the KV cache inconsistency happened.
laura: All good. If anything changes ping me here. Otherwise see you Wed 10:30 PST. :thumbsup:
sanjay: Thank you everyone — appreciate quick responses.
laura: tagging final attendees in invite: sanjay, laura, rachel, mike, ying, @cust-sre, @platform-deploy
ops-bot: PIR checklist: agenda, pre-read, action-tracker (empty actions added).
